subject.title: Session lock uses fail-fast OCC instead of serializing writers — EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError / reply session init conflicts under concurrent subagent load

question: Which successful subagent completions must remain durably deliverable after retry exhaustion, and should additional concurrent prompt writes be reconciled without holding the transcript lock across the model call?
rationale: Current code intentionally limits durable suspension to required successful keep-mode completions and intentionally releases the transcript lock during prompts; broadening either contract affects cleanup, cancellation, concurrency, and delivery semantics.

options.title: Broaden durable delivery
options.body: Retain every contract-required successful completion after retry exhaustion while preserving merge-aware prompt lock release.

options.title: Redesign session ownership
options.body: Introduce a per-session writer queue with explicit rules for prompt execution, live turns, cleanup, cancellation, and transcript publication.

options.title: Keep current contract
options.body: Continue treating non-required or non-keep outcomes as terminal and limit changes to diagnostics and narrower conflict reconciliation.

recommendation.title: Broaden durable delivery
recommendation.body: Retain every contract-required successful completion after retry exhaustion while preserving merge-aware prompt lock release.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history connects this owner to both the delivery lifecycle contract and verified session-rewrite fencing.
